text:
maya: Deploybot failing to publish redwood/frontend:2026.03.21 -> europe-west2 (GCR). Attestation signature mismatch from mirror. Can someone pick this up?

maya: ```
[2026-03-21T13:10:02Z] publish: redwood/frontend:2026.03.21 -> europe-west2
info: layers uploaded
error: attestation verification: SIGNATURE_MISMATCH (expected key id 0x9f7a, got 0x8b2c)
deploybot: aborting publish
```

deploybot: automated: publish failed for `redwood/frontend:2026.03.21` (attempt 1). See https://deploybot.internal/jobs/99012 for logs.

oliver: mirror shows image present in gcr-eu but attestation blob is there with different key id. did we rotate cosign keys earlier?

infra-bot: yes, key rotation happened at 2026-03-20T22:00Z. Reconciliation job should have propagated new key, but cosign-verifier on europe-west2 is still using cached trust bundle (last sync 03:00 UTC).

release-manager: hold all EU canaries for this release until we confirm attestation consistency. set `region_skip=europe-west2` for rollout.

legal: note: for EU customers under DPA we require provenance attestation to be verified by production verifier. We cannot bypass checks. Manual re-sign/replay must include why and who.

oliver: options: A) re-sign attestation with new key and attach to existing image (cosign attest), B) retag last-known-good digest and republish under a new tag, or C) block and rollback canary globally. Thoughts?

ci-cd: we have a republish job `release/republish-manual` that can attach attestation if provided with key. but that requires keys in a secure step and audit metadata.

maya: prefer B for speed (retag+push to gcr-eu as `2026.03.21-eu-republish`) plus audit labels. then run smoke. If infra can fix verifier in 45m we can replace with A later and merge notes.

infra-bot: verifier sync fix in progress. ETA ~40m. KMS truststore rotation incomplete on eu verifier nodes.

legal: if you do B, include image labels: `manual_republish=true`, `manual_republisher=<github-username>`, `manual_republish_reason=attestation-key-mismatch`. Also create an audit ticket #AUD-4512 and link it in the PR.

oliver: i'll do the retag and PR. will add labels and the ticket link. will also add a short release note: "temporary EU republish due to attestation key rotation; original digest unchanged."

release-manager: add hold note to release doc and notify downstream teams. set rollback timer: if verifier not healthy in 2h, rollback EU clusters to 2026.03.13 (stable).

ci-cd: kicking off manual republish pipeline now: `./scripts/republish --digest sha256:deadbeef1234 --target-tag 2026.03.21-eu-republish --labels manual_republisher=oliver,manual_republish=true`

deploybot: automated: pausing further publish attempts to europe-west2 for release 2026.03.21 while `region_override=europe-west2` is active.

oliver: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4299 — contains retag, labels, audit ticket link, and republish instructions. starting push.

infra-bot: verifier nodes in eu-west2 now syncing trust bundle. healthcheck: `curl -fsS https://verifier.eu.internal/health -> 200`

maya: nice. SRE please run smoke tests after republish completes.

sre-ops: on it. once republish finishes we'll run `smoke/regression --region eu-west2 --image sha256:deadbeef1234` and basic e2e flows. standing by.

oliver: push completed. image `redwood/frontend:2026.03.21-eu-republish` -> digest sha256:deadbeef1234. added labels `manual_republish=true`, `manual_republisher=oliver`, `manual_republish_reason=attestation-key-mismatch`.

sre-ops: smoke started. latency, auth flows, and signup happy path look good so far.

maya: thanks. i'm updating the release notes and locking the canary window until QA sign-off. once verifier sync is fully propagated we'll consider replacing tag with original if needed.

release-manager: decision log: prefer republish-with-label over disabling attestation. rollback plan in place if smoke fails or verifier not healthy in 2h. tagging this thread `gcr-eu-republish-3169992222`.

deploybot: automated: resuming normal publish attempts in other regions. europe-west2 remains skipped for release 2026.03.21.

legal: confirm audit ticket link in PR and that CI job recorded who triggered the republish. all good from compliance side.

maya: will close when verifier is stable and we either reconcile attestation or complete rollback. great job everyone.
